# Befree Inc

> Befree Inc is a Canadian technology company based in Ontario (Greater Toronto Area). It digitizes business processes, migrates legacy systems to modern stacks and provides managed engineering outsourcing, and it owns and operates its own products.

## Pages
- Capabilities: https://befreefit.ca/capabilities.html
- Migration: https://befreefit.ca/migration.html
- Work done: https://befreefit.ca/work.html

## Capabilities
- Process digitization: workflow and approval automation, document processing, dashboards and integrations.
- Stack migration and modernization: re-platforming, data and cloud migration (AWS, GCP), CI/CD and observability.
- Managed outsourcing: programmes, dedicated teams, application support and maintenance.
- Technology leadership: fractional CTO, architecture review, technical due diligence.

## Own products and modules
- BeFree app (https://www.befree.fit/): food and nutrition app. Modules: identity and access, profiles and preferences, AI product analysis, history and insights. Live.
- JobPulse (jobpulse.work): in build. No public details yet.

## FAQ
- What does Befree Inc do? Befree Inc is a Canadian technology company. We digitize business processes, migrate legacy systems to modern stacks and provide managed engineering outsourcing, and we own and operate our own products, including the BeFree food and nutrition app.
- How do you migrate a legacy system without disrupting the business? We move in phases. Each wave has a target design and a rollback path, old and new systems run in parallel where needed, and data is reconciled before cutover.
- Do you take on outsourced engineering? Yes. We run defined programmes, managed engineering teams and application support, with agreed outcomes and clear ownership.
- Where is Befree Inc based? We are based in Ontario, Canada, in the Greater Toronto Area. We serve Canada, the United States and India, with delivery supported by our partner Anvira Labs.
- What is the BeFree app? BeFree is a personalized food and nutrition app that we own. It builds a profile from your health goals and dietary needs, scans products and flags ingredients and allergens that matter to you. Learn more at befree.fit.
- How does an engagement start? Email info@befreefit.ca or book a call. We begin with an assessment of your processes and systems to agree scope, risks and phases.
